title: Domain Setup — Review and Customize Pre-filled Domain Files
description: Set up the domain documentation for a new project. The domain files come pre-filled with working defaults. This task reviews them, answers the clarifying questions in SETUP.md, creates a project-specific README.md, and customizes them for your specific project.

goals.title: Review and customize domain files
goals.description: Read each domain file (DOMAIN.md, capabilities.md, conventions.md, constraints.md, terminology.md), identify what needs project-specific customization, and fill in the details. The files come pre-filled with working defaults — only customize where your project differs.

steps.action: Read docs/domain/DOMAIN.md and note sections needing project-specific rules
Read docs/domain/capabilities.md and update with project-specific capabilities
Read docs/domain/conventions.md and fill in language-specific conventions
Read docs/domain/constraints.md and add project-specific constraints
Read docs/domain/terminology.md and add project-specific terms

goals.title: Answer clarifying questions
goals.description: Answer all 6 clarifying questions in SETUP.md to gather project information and fill in the blanks in the domain files.

steps.action: Answer Question 1: What is your project? (language/paradigm)
Answer Question 2: What are your non-negotiable constraints?
Answer Question 3: What is your sandbox's build access policy?
Answer Question 4: What capabilities should the agent have?
Answer Question 5: What naming/convention rules apply?
Answer Question 6: What does done look like for your project?

goals.title: Create project README
goals.description: Convert the template's SETUP.md into your project's README.md. This involves tailoring the quick start instructions, replacing generic examples with your project specifics, and moving the clarifying questions to an appendix or separate document.

steps.action: Read SETUP.md and identify content that is project-specific vs. template-generic
Create README.md with project introduction, SDLC concepts, and quick start
Move clarifying questions to appendix or keep as-is if they apply

goals.title: Deep-dive research
goals.description: Research dependencies, patterns, and tools from authoritative documentation sources (latest stable versions) and document findings where relevant in the domain files.

steps.action: Identify all dependencies your project will use
Research each dependency from official documentation (latest stable version)
Document dependency inclusion and usage patterns in conventions.md

goals.title: Validate and finalize
goals.description: Run validate_domain.py, confirm exit code 0, and update state.md to mark completion. The domain is ready to load into the system prompt.

steps.action: Run python scripts/validate_domain.py
Fix any errors reported by validate_domain.py
Run validate_domain.py again to confirm exit code 0
Update state.md to mark all goals complete and add completion date

goals.title: Initialize Project Layer
goals.description: Create docs/project/ with the placeholder structure so tasks have a place to store task-agnostic knowledge.

steps.action: Create docs/project/ directory with research/, design/, reference/, architecture/ subdirectories
Copy placeholder READMEs from the template into each subdirectory
